This section focuses on pavement Ground Penetrating Radar (GPR), including FDTD simulation of layered and heterogeneous pavement systems, layer interfaces, thin layers, cracks, voids, moisture, and groundwater effects.

## Articles & Technical Notes

### [GPR-01 | Building a Virtual Ground Penetrating Radar Laboratory with FDTD](../posts/gpr-virtual-laboratory/index.qmd)

**October 8, 2026 · GPR Article Series**

Using a controlled FDTD-based virtual pavement laboratory, this article examines how uniform and irregular pavement layers, idealized cracks, a thin water layer, thin asphalt concrete, and a circular subsurface void influence GPR A-scans and B-scans. Includes numerical experiments, figures, and animations.

[Read GPR-01 →](../posts/gpr-virtual-laboratory/index.qmd)

*GPR-02 will explore more realistic heterogeneous pavement structures, including internal material structure, cracking, moisture, and compaction.*
